I solved level 2 in 19 actions. The human baseline is 33.

How the game works on this level:
- **The rule:** each blob sits at the centroid (average position) of the points in its chain. The points are the 0-token and the 3-tokens. You win when each blob reaches the diamond of the same colour. The position only needs to be close.
- **Clicks:** a click on an empty cell moves the 0-token there. A click on a 3-token swaps it with the 0-token. When one chain was done, a click on a 3-token of the next chain moved the 0-token into that chain.
- **Blocked moves:** a move fails if the blob would land on the `a` area. Nothing changes, but the action is still charged. This cost me 2 actions: once at the start, and once in the f-chain. My first test click on the `a` area also did nothing.
- **Sequences:** in one multi-click sequence, the clicks after the first one also did nothing. So I sent single clicks after that.

I saved these rules as a global memory (`arc_0b529a18_l2`), so later instances of this game can use them.
